messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 502/504 error rate detected in us-west-2 API gateway (5m window > 12%): service=inference-gateway, route=/v1/generate. Paging @oncall-jen :rotating_light:

oncall-jen: I'm on it, joining. Can someone confirm if this is isolated to us-west-2?

sre-max: I'm seeing high 502s on the gw logs for us-west-2. Upstream responses are timing out to model-serving instances (connect timeout ~ 1.2s in logs).

infra-alex: Checking host-level metrics now — CPU on the model fleet in us-west-2 looks normal, but network retries are spiking on the egress NAT gateway.

pagermike: FYI ops-runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/gateway-502. Suggest we start failover routing for new requests to us-east-1 while we triage.

oncall-jen: Agreed. Initiating regional failover policy to prefer us-east-1 for routes that can tolerate cross-region latency. Applying routing override.

deploy-bot: ROUTING-CHANGE: override route priority applied by oncall-jen for service=inference-gateway, prefer_region=us-east-1. Change id: rchg-8934

support-liz: Fielding incoming CS tickets — initial triage: ~22 customers reporting failed requests (timeouts/502) in last 20m, mostly interactive chat endpoints. Not all requests retried.

customer-success-amy: Which customers are affected? Need to prepare an update for those on Dedicated plans.

sre-max: Partial list: acme-analytics, shopflow, medlytics. I'll attach sample request/response:

```
REQUEST: POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Body: {"prompt":"Summarize..."}
RESPONSE: 502 Bad Gateway
Upstream: connect timeout after 1203ms
```

infra-alex: NAT gateway metrics show burst NAT port exhaustion in us-west-2 at 17:04UTC, concurrent connections jumped ~4x due to background model cache refill after a small scaling event. That explains timeouts.

oncall-jen: Ok, immediate mitigations: 1) Increase NAT pool (apply ephemeral port limit bump), 2) Enable short-term request shedding for non-critical routes, 3) Route new user requests to us-east-1. Who can apply NAT change?

infra-alex: I can bump the NAT ephemeral port allocation and spin up an extra NAT instance. Doing `terraform apply` now.

```
# terraform snippet
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "extra" {
  allocation_id = "eip-xxxx"
  subnet_id = "subnet-abc"
}
```

deploy-bot: DEPLOYMENT: terraform apply started by infra-alex (plan id: tf-4578).

sre-max: Also enabling aggressive connection pooling on the gateway side (reduce backend connection churn). Pushing config: `gateway.pool.max_idle=500`, `gateway.pool.idle_timeout=60s`.

pagermike: I'll add a temporary rule to return 429 for non-essential endpoints (metrics, async batch jobs) to preserve ports for interactive endpoints.

support-liz: Sending an advisory to affected customers now: "We're seeing elevated 5xx responses in US-WEST-2 and have temporarily routed traffic to US-EAST-1 and applied mitigations. We're monitoring and will update in 30 minutes."

oncall-jen: infra-alex, any ETA on NAT scale?

infra-alex: NAT instance + route propagation should be up in ~4 minutes. Terraform apply succeeded, allocating EIP. Verifying connectivity.

sre-max: After routing override + NAT scale we see 502 rate drop from 12% -> 3% in 2 minutes. Latency to us-east-1 +80ms p50, but acceptable for interactive flows.

customer-success-amy: Thanks — I'll push the update to the customer Slack channels and mark high-touch customers for one-off reach-outs.

oncall-jen: Let's prepare to hand off to daytime on-call in 20m. @sre-max will stay to confirm stabilization, then handoff to @pagermike.

sre-max: I'll stay. Current status: partial outage contained, cross-region failover in effect, mitigations applied (NAT scaled, pool tuned, request-shedding). Keeping monitoring dashboards up.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigations applied: routing_override=us-east-1, nat_scale=+1, gateway_pool_tuned=true, temporary_shedding=true.

pagermike: When handing off, include runbook step to revert routing_override after traffic normalizes and to coordinate DNS TTL if needed.

oncall-jen: Will do. Final note before handoff: owners, please follow up with a postmortem root cause: NAT port exhaustion during cache refill; include recommendations for longer-term solutions (e.g., persistent NAT pools, regional autoscaling of NATs, or client-side backoff).

support-liz: Logged customer incidents and created escalation tickets for Dedicated customers requiring credits.

sre-max: last check: 502 rate ~1.1% in us-west-2, overall platform healthy. Handing off in 15m to pagermike.

pagermike: Taking handoff at 1769001298. I'll run another verification sweep and open a follow-up incident doc. :white_check_mark:
